title: Rangers transfer talk: Danny Armstrong plays down the Ibrox rumour
body:
Dinamo Bucharest winger Danny Armstrong is publicly cooling a link with Rangers, saying he has not been in discussions with Derek McInnes about a switch to Ibrox [S1]. The denial is the first thing to weigh.

The same BBC coverage also downplays talk of Jack Grealish moving to Celtic [S1]. A second BBC piece goes the other way, saying Armstrong would relish a reunion with his manager at Ibrox and that a Celtic hero has revealed an approach from Rangers [S2]. Both accounts cannot be fully right, and the reporting does not show which one is closer to the truth [S1][S2].

There are no form figures or predictions in the material, so this debate runs on mood music rather than performance. Nobody has shown how the winger has been playing, or what the odds of a deal really look like.

Talk is cheap until the paperwork is signed, so every rumour deserves suspicion. If a move like this does happen, it says a lot about where the club thinks it is heading.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: Armstrong plays down talk of Rangers transfer - gossip. Dinamo Bucharest winger Danny Armstrong says he has not talked with Rangers manager Derek McInnes about a move to Ibrox, while the chances of Jack Grealish joining Celtic are played down.
